sampler: Python random.randrange over the three frozen pilot training rows; persist random state and consumed optimizer steps
checkpoint: Adapter tensors, optimizer, scheduler, ordered parameter names, completed steps, history, Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all CUDA RNG; local trusted file only, torch.load(weights_only=True).
negative_control: Restore adapter, RNG, consumed steps and scheduler/LR, but deliberately reset AdamW moment estimates and step counters. Do not conflate with a quality comparison.
determinism: Same Windows/GPU and pinned software, deterministic algorithms, math SDPA, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, TF32 off, AdamW foreach/fused off.
acceptance: Continuous vs full resume: identical per-step histories, adapter tensors, optimizer/scheduler/RNG state and sampler position. Optimizer-reset must diverge. Four phases use fresh subprocesses. No retries chosen for favorable scores.
scope: Real GPU LoRA engineering test on three synthetic training notices, not quality training. No padding/packing, batch=1, no gradient accumulation, no AMP scaler, no multi-worker/distributed loader or arbitrary microstep recovery.
publication: Keep checkpoints and debug weights local; sync engineering evidence documents only, preserve existing private HF branch weights and main.
